## Summary

Widmison Francois is a Florida-based Full-Stack Web Developer, AI Digital Marketing Strategist, creator of Mex509, and Founder of Royol Technology. He builds high-performance web applications with Next.js, TypeScript, Python, and FastAPI, and engineers AI-powered digital growth systems. Through generative AI video/audio pipelines, retention data, and cross-platform syndication, he scaled Royol Technology to 1,017,000+ (1M+) combined followers.
